dimensions.name: Customer acquisition readiness
dimensions.blocker: The public site and funnel measurement are substantially stronger and live payment infrastructure is deployed, but the running product still cannot release a real paid order until the production release-verification path is wired. There is also no repeatable real-traffic to paid-customer loop or measured CAC.

dimensions.name: Business / economic proof
dimensions.blocker: There is still no verified paying SelfOperate/Business Builder cohort, recurring revenue, CAC, gross margin, retention or paid-delivery economics. Product readiness does not substitute for external economic proof.

changed: The biggest change is a truth correction rather than a simple upward step. SelfOperate now has live payment infrastructure and production transactional email, and the directly relevant Stromation website stack gained a stronger calibrated builder and deployment parity. But the same day's release and connector audits made two gaps explicit: the running product still cannot release a live customer charge because the paid-pilot verification layer is not wired, and several capabilities previously described too broadly are actually read-only, shadow-mode or still coming soon. That lowers several current-readiness scores despite real engineering progress; the website-generation score rises because the new builder-polish stack is merged, while full unattended website delivery remains unproven.
method: Business Builder/SelfOperate-only independent forecast grounded in the 2026-09-25 canonical dariusstrongman/businessbuilder main through 602d56f, the live selfoperate.com deployment at product commit 70cb342, current deployment documentation, live payment and transactional-email state, the deployed Build My Website purchase-path correction, the honest-claims audit, open founder-release work that is not credited as complete, and only directly relevant Stromation website evidence through e44e49e. The archived buisnessbuilder-future repo is historical only. Unrelated Stromation ventures, company-wide autonomy and Stromation customer/revenue status are excluded. Forward-looking values are estimates, not guarantees.
